definitions.sold: qualifying sales on the Registration Spreadsheets (registrar named, CRM/student ID present, not cancelled)
definitions.matched: sales whose CRM number appears in the FileMaker report
definitions.paid_any: matched sales with Total Learner Payment > 0
definitions.paying_status: Learner_Status in Current / Fully Paid / Course Complete / On Hold / Study Break
definitions.note: Payments are cumulative to the report date, so young cohorts look worse than they will end up; compare like-for-like ages.
